scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Aapki zindagi ka ek lamba safar tay ho chuka hai. Ab waqt hai peeche mud kar dekhne ka...

scenes.speaker: System
scenes.text: (Developer Hub) Choose your ending based on stats:

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Kamyabi! Aapne dunya aur aakhirat dono mein tawazun qaim rakha. Allah ne aapke rizq aur waqt mein barkat daali.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Aapke paas paisa bohot hai, lekin sukoon nahi. Aapne dunya jeet li, par deen peeche chhoot gaya.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Paisa zyada nahi kamaya, magar ilm aur deen mein aage nikal gaye. Log aapki izzat karte hain.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Aap masharay mein ek moazziz shakhsiyat ban gaye. Log aapke mashware ke mohtaj rehte hain.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Dunya ki daud mein sab kuch kho diya. Na paisa bacha, na izzat, na iman.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Bohot ameer hone ke bawajood, log aapse nafrat karte hain. Apne zameer ka sauda kar liya.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Dunya se kinara kashi ikhtiyar kar li. Sakht zindagi guzari, par Allah se qareeb ho gaye.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Duniya ka ilm hasil kiya aur bade scientist/thinker ban gaye, magar roohaniyat ki kami reh gayi.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Zindagi bhar ghaltiyan ki, par aakhir mein tauba ka rasta chuna. Umeed hai Allah muaf karega.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Gumnam zindagi guzari, logon ne ahmiyat nahi di. Par asman walo ke nazdeek aap bohot khas the.
